[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on how to display handmade candles at an upcoming event.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your past successes! Displaying handmade candles can be a delicate task, but with some creativity and planning, you can create an eye-catching display that showcases your products beautifully.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for creating a stunning display include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. **Theme and Color Scheme**: Choose a theme or color scheme that complements your candles.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. **Tiered Displays**: Use tiered displays or shelves to create a visually interesting layout.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. **Group Similar Items Together**: Group candles by scent, color, or type.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. **Create a Focal Point**: Designate a central candle or arrangement as the focal point.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. **Add Decorative Elements**: Incorporate greenery, flowers, or decorative stones.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. **Use Lighting to Your Advantage**: Consider using spotlights or soft lighting.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. **Signage and Labels**: Use clear signage and labels for products.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. **Interactive Elements**: Consider adding interactive elements to engage customers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. **Keep it Simple**: Don't overcrowd your display.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. **Practice Makes Perfect**: Set up a mock display to test layouts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular display ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - A rustic wooden crate or box display with candles arranged by scent or color.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - A tiered glass or acrylic display with candles grouped by type.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - A colorful, bohemian-inspired display with candles nestled among greenery.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - A modern, minimalist display with candles on a sleek shelf.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Remember to take photos of your display before the event and share them on social media.
